p1: From the street, my new house has four windows upstairs.
From the inside, I've only ever found three.
I counted twice the day I moved in. The realtor just smiled. The last owner never really moved out.
Then, at two in the morning, the fourth window lit up.
I stood in the yard and watched a shadow pace behind the curtain.
Upstairs, the wall between my room and the bathroom sounded hollow.
Last night, I tore off the wallpaper. There was a door.
I ran outside to count the windows again. Four lights were on.
One of them was my room. And I never leave my light on.
Follow. I'm not going back inside tonight.
